appraisal_events.evidence: Saint-Loup holds the floor for a long, closely argued exposition of the world of possible plans, Ulm, the obsolescence of the 1895 Service en Campagne; his fellow officer answers « Saint-Loup a raison et il est probable que le prochain Service en Campagne portera la trace de cette évolution », and later builds on him — « j'ajouterai à ce que tu viens de dire ».
appraisal_events.explanation: A professional peer ratifies his argument and then extends it rather than correcting it, and the narrator, who listens « avec assez d'avidité », lets the whole demonstration stand unqualified.

appraisal_events.evidence: « car tes avis semblent faire plus impression que les miens sur mon ami », said laughing but with something « qui l'agaçât un peu »; the narrator answers « Ne sois pas si susceptible » and the comrade resumes with « Si tu veux bien ne plus prendre la mouche ».
appraisal_events.explanation: In the middle of his triumph he betrays a proprietary irritation at the friendship forming beside him, and both interlocutors name him touchy in the same breath.

status_effects.explanation: He commands the conversation at length on technical ground and is confirmed, not contested, by the one man present competent to judge.
He shows he needs to remain the narrator's chief authority and is twice asked, in company, to stop taking offense.

ambiguities: The narrator offers two readings of the same remark — that the growing sympathy between his comrade and himself annoyed Saint-Loup, or that he thought it graceful to consecrate it officially — so the pique is registered by the scene while its motive is left open.
